info.description: Definitive Healthcare Corp. engages in the provision of healthcare commercial intelligence. Its solution offers information on healthcare providers and their activities to help the customers optimize from product development to go-to-market planning, sales, and marketing execution. The company was founded by Jason Kranzt in February 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Definitive Healthcare Corp. 從事提供醫療保健商業情報。其解決方案提供有關醫療保健提供者及其活動的信息，以幫助客戶優化從產品開發到上市規劃、銷售和行銷執行的整個過程。該公司由 Jason Kranzt 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BRBI BR Partners SA engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the finance segment. The company was founded by Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda in 2009 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: BRBI BR Partners SA 從事提供銀行服務。它透過金融部門運作。該公司由 Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda 於 2009 年創立，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: Intrusion, Inc. is a cybersecurity company, which offers customers access to its exclusive threat intelligence database containing the historical data, known associations, and reputational behavior of Internet Protocol addresses. Its solutions include INTRUSION Shield, INTRUSION TraceCop, and INTRUSION Savant. The company was founded by T. Joe Head and G. Ward Paxton in September 1983 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Intrusion, Inc. 是一家網路安全公司，為客戶提供存取其獨家威脅情報資料庫的權限，其中包含網際網路協定位址的歷史資料、已知關聯和聲譽行為。其解決方案包括 INTRUSION Shield、INTRUSION TraceCop 和 INTRUSION Savant。該公司由 T. Joe Head 和 G. Ward Paxton 於 1983 年 9 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: XP, Inc. engages in the operation of technology-driven financial services platform. The firm provides customers with two principal types of offerings, financial advisory services for retail clients in Brazil, high-net-worth clients, international clients and corporate and institutional clients, and an open financial product platform providing access to over 800 investment products including equity and fixed income securities, mutual and hedge funds, structured products, life insurance, pension plans, real-estate investment funds (REITs) and others from XP, its partners and competitors. he company was founded by Guilherme Dias Fernandes Benchimol in 2001 and is headquartered in Vila Olimpia, Brazil.

info.description: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively investing in equity securities of energy-related companies or instruments providing exposure to energy-related companies. The strategy targets full market capitalization representation across the energy sector to minimize tracking error and performance deviation relative to traditional broad sector benchmarks.
info.description_zh: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF 透過積極投資能源相關公司的股本證券或提供能源相關公司曝險的工具來尋求長期資本增值。該策略的目標是整個能源行業的完整市值代表性，以最大限度地減少相對於傳統廣泛行業基準的追蹤誤差和績效偏差。

info.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. engages in the business of acquiring, developing, gathering, and producing natural gas and oil reserves. It operates through the following segments: Upstream, and Gathering System. The Upstream segment includes the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas reserves. The Gathering System segment deals with natural gas gathering system. The company was founded by Zoran Arandjelovic and John K. Wilson on March 14, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Epsilon Energy Ltd. 從事收購、開發、收集和生產天然氣和石油儲備的業務。它透過以下部分運作：上游和收集系統。上游部門包括石油和天然氣儲量的收購、勘探、開發和生產。收集系統部門涉及天然氣收集系統。該公司由 Zoran Arandjelovic 和 John K. Wilson 於 2005 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Taylor Devices, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of shock absorption, rate control, and energy storage devices. Its products include metal bellows dampers, fluid viscous dampers, landing and arresting gear, pumpkin mounts, isolation systems, custom applications, crane buffers, shock absorbers, liquid die springs, lock up devices, machined springs, and actuators. The company was founded by Paul H. Taylor on July 22, 1955 and is headquartered in North Tonawanda, NY.
info.description_zh: Taylor Devices, Inc. 從事減震、速率控制和儲能設備的設計、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括金屬波紋管阻尼器、流體黏性阻尼器、著陸和煞車裝置、南瓜支架、隔離系統、客製化應用、起重機緩衝器、避震器、液體模具彈簧、鎖定裝置、機械加工彈簧和執行器。該公司由 Paul H. Taylor 於 1955 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州北托納旺達。

info.description: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in drug research and development to create new therapies for fibrotic disease, severe skin disease, and cancer. Its programs target the development of carbohydrate molecules which offers alternative options to larger market segments. The company was founded by James C. Czirr and Anatole A. Klyosov on July 10, 2000 and is headquartered in Norcross, GA.
info.description_zh: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於藥物研發，為纖維化疾病、嚴重皮膚病和癌症創造新療法。其計劃的目標是開發碳水化合物分子，為更大的細分市場提供替代選擇。該公司由 James C. Czirr 和 Anatole A. Klyosov 於 2000 年 7 月 10 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州諾克羅斯。

info.description: Exelixis, Inc. is an oncology company, which focuses on discovering, developing, and commercialization of new medicines for difficult-to-treat cancers. Its products include cabometyx, cometriq, and cotellic. The company was founded by Stelios Papadopoulos on November 15, 1994, and is headquartered in Alameda, CA.

The company was founded on December 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Incline Village, NV.
info.description_zh: RMG ML Sports Holdings 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年12月16日，總部位於內華達州因克萊恩村。

info.description: Art Technology Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Art Technology Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月22日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. engages in the production of oilseeds, corn, wheat, cocoa, and other agricultural commodities. It operates through the following segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, Nutrition, and Other. The Ag Services and Oilseeds segment includes activities related to the origination, merchandising, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, and the crushing and further processing of oilseeds such as soybeans and soft seeds cottonseed, sunflower seed, canola, rapeseed, and flaxseed into vegetable oils and protein meals. The Carbohydrate Solutions segment consists of corn and wheat wet and dry milling and other activities. The Nutrition segment serves various end markets including food, beverages, nutritional supplements, and feed and premix for livestock, aquaculture, and pet food. The Other segment refers to the company's remaining operations. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. 從事油籽、玉米、小麥、可可和其他農產品的生產。它透過以下部門運作：農業服務和油籽部門、碳水化合物解決方案部門、營養部門和其他部門。農業服務和油籽部門包括與農業原料的原產地、銷售、運輸和儲存有關的活動，以及將大豆和軟籽棉籽、葵花籽、油菜籽、油菜籽和亞麻籽等油籽壓榨和深加工成植物油和蛋白粉的活動。碳水化合物解決方案部門包括玉米和小麥的濕磨和乾磨以及其他活動。營養部門服務於各種終端市場，包括食品、飲料、營養補充劑以及牲畜、水產養殖和寵物食品的飼料和預混料。其他部門是指公司的剩餘業務。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: S&P Global, Inc. engages in the provision of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide. It operates through the following segments: Ratings, Indices, Energy, and Market Intelligence. The Ratings segment provides credit ratings, research, and analytics. The Indices segment maintains a wide variety of valuation and index benchmarks for investment advisors, wealth managers, and institutional investors. The Energy segment is involved in information and benchmark prices for the energy and commodity markets. The Market Intelligence segment covers multi-asset-class data and analytics integrated with purpose-built workflow solutions. The company was founded by James H. McGraw and John A. Hill in 1917 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: S&P Global, Inc. 致力於向全球資本和商品市場提供透明和獨立的評級、基準、分析和數據。它透過以下部門運作：評級、指數、能源和市場情報。評級部門提供信用評級、研究和分析。指數部門為投資顧問、財富管理機構和機構投資者維護各種估值和指數基準。能源部門涉及能源和商品市場的資訊和基準價格。市場情報部門涵蓋與專門建構的工作流程解決方案整合的多資產類別資料和分析。該公司由 James H. McGraw 和 John A. Hill 於 1917 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Conduent, Inc. delivers digital business solutions and services spanning the commercial, government and transportation spectrum creating valuable outcomes for clients and the millions of people who count on them. The cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation and advanced analytics deliver mission-critical solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Industries, Government Services, and Transportation. The Commercial Industries segment offers business process services and customized solutions to clients in a variety of industries. The Government Services segment is involved in government-centric business process services and subject matter experts to U.S. federal, state, and local and foreign governments. The Transportation segment includes systems and support to transportation departments and agencies globally. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.

info.description: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of conditionally activated, biologics localized to the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Gluck and Nancy E. Stagliano in September 2010 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc.是一家專注於腫瘤學的臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對腫瘤微環境的條件激活生物製劑。該公司由 Frederick W. Gluck 和 Nancy E. Stagliano 於 2010 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: DAXOR Corporation is an innovative medical instrumentation and biotechnology company. DAXOR designed and developed the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer. It is the first instrument approved by the FDA to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's true blood volume. We believe that the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer has the potential to transform therapy in a broad range of surgical and medical conditions. It is our goal, working in conjunction with hospitals and clinics, to achieve that possibility. The BVA-100 is a semi-automated Blood Volume Analyzer. It is used in conjunction with a single use diagnostic kit. It is the first FDA-approved instrument to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's blood volume.

info.description: MetaVia, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing and commercializing multi-modal disease-modifying therapies. Its pipeline includes ANA001, a proprietary oral niclosamide formulation, Gemcabene, which is assessed as an acute indication for COVID-19, NB-01, a treatment for painful diabetic neuropathy, and NB-02, which has the potential to treat the symptoms of cognitive impairment and modify the progression of neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 30, 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: MetaVia, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發和商業化多模式疾病緩解療法。其產品線包括 ANA001（一種專有的口服氯硝柳胺製劑）、Gemcabene（被評估為 COVID-19 的急性適應症）、NB-01（一種治療疼痛性糖尿病神經病變的藥物）和 NB-02（有潛力治療認知障礙症狀並改變神經退化性疾病的進展）。該公司成立於2014年10月30日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Pacira Biosciences, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of non-opioid pain management and regenerative health solutions to improve patients' journeys along the neural pain pathway. Its products include EXPAREL, iovera, and DepoFoam. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

info.description: Prothena Corp. Plc is a clinical-stage neuroscience company, which engages in the discovery and development of novel therapies to change the course of devastating diseases. The firm's clinical pipeline includes both wholly owned and partnered programs being developed for the potential treatment of diseases including AL amyloidosis, ATTR amyloidosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded in December 1969 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Prothena Corp. Plc 是一家臨床階段的神經科學公司，致力於發現和開發新療法以改變破壞性疾病的進程。該公司的臨床管道包括正在開發的全資和合作項目，用於潛在治療 AL 澱粉樣變性、ATTR 澱粉樣變性、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症和其他神經退化性疾病。該公司成立於1969年12月，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SMCI ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Super Micro Computer Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SMCI ETF 旨在透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售超微電腦公司普通股選擇權產生的，該基金旨在提供 2 倍 (200%) 基礎股票每日表現，並獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 的表現上限，但受潛在投資收益上限，但受潛在投資收益上限的限制。可能會實施下行保護，這可能會影響淨利潤水準。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Oil Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; secondary objective being exposure to the performance of United States Oil Fund, LP ("USO") subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the share price of United States Oil Fund, LP, subject to a limit on potential gains related to increases in the price of USO's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Oil 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；次要目標是了解美國石油基金有限合夥人（「USO」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 United States Oil Fund, LP 股價的機會，但受到與 USO 股價上漲相關的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 18, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: SBA Communications Corp. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of wireless communications infrastructures. It operates through the following business segments: Domestic Site Leasing, International Site Leasing, and Site Development. The Domestic Site Leasing segment includes AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile, and Verizon Wireless. The International Site Leasing segment acquires and develops towers. The Site Development segment is involved in consulting and construction activities. The company was founded by Steven E. Bernstein in 1989 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: SBA Communications Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事提供無線通訊基礎設施業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：國內場地租賃、國際場地租賃和場地開發。國內站點租賃部門包括 AT&T、Sprint、T-Mobile 和 Verizon Wireless。國際場地租賃部門收購和開發塔樓。場地開發部門從事諮詢和建設活動。該公司由 Steven E. Bernstein 於 1989 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: AB Core Plus Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in fixed-income securities. It may invest in a broad range of debt securities, including corporate bonds and debt and mortgage- and other asset-backed securities issued by U.S. government-sponsored entities and federal agencies and instrumentalities that are not backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. government.

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Emerging Markets Infrastructure IndexTM, which is designed to track the performance of 30 of the largest publicly listed companies in the infrastructure industry in emerging markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 新興市場基礎設施​​ ETF 旨在追蹤標普新興市場基礎設施​​指數™的投資結果，該指數旨在追蹤新興市場基礎設施​​產業 30 家最大的上市公司的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Warner Music Group Corp. engages in the publishing and recording of music. It operates through the Recorded Music and Music Publishing segments. The Recorded Music segment is involved in the sale, marketing, distribution, and licensing of recorded music produced by the company's recording artists. The Music Publishing segment acts as a copyright owner and/or administrator of the musical compositions and generates revenues related to the exploitation of musical compositions. The company was founded on November 21, 2003 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 華納音樂集團公司從事音樂出版和錄製。它透過錄製音樂和音樂出版部門運作。錄製音樂部門涉及公司唱片藝術家製作的錄製音樂的銷售、行銷、分銷和授權。音樂出版部門充當音樂作品的版權所有者和/或管理員，並產生與音樂作品的利用相關的收入。該公司成立於2003年11月21日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index. This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, as well as mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities-all with maturities of more than 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美國總流通量調整指數的表現。 This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, Y 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate to high level of current income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生中等到高水準的當前收入。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF seeks high current income without undue risk to principal. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in debt securities and in derivatives and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to such securities. The fund may invest up to 20% of its net assets in foreign debt securities, including non-U.S. dollar- denominated securities and securities of companies in emerging market countries (i.e., those that are in the early stages of their industrial cycles).
info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高当期收入，且不对本金造成不当风险。一般情况下，基金至少80%的资产投资于债务证券以及具有与此类证券类似经济特征的衍生品和其他工具。該基金最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外債證券，包括非美元計價的證券和新興市場國家（即處於工業週期早期階段的國家）公司的證券。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: The Eastern Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of engineered solutions. The firm primarily provides engineered solutions support in the commercial transportation and logistics markets. The company was founded by Eben Tuttle in October 1858 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: The Eastern Co. 從事工程解決方案的設計、製造和銷售。該公司主要為商業運輸和物流市場提供工程解決方案支援。該公司由 Eben Tuttle 於 1858 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: Polyrizon Ltd. is a development stage biotech company, which engages in the development of nasal hydrogels. It provides barriers from the interaction of biological assaults, including a new strain of coronavirus, influenza, allergens and other airborne pathogens with the nasal epithelial tissue. The company was founded by Tomer Izraeli in January 2005 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Polyrizon Ltd.是一家處於發展階段的生物技術公司，從事鼻腔水凝膠的開發。它為生物攻擊提供了屏障，包括新型冠狀病毒、流感、過敏原和其他空氣傳播的病原體與鼻上皮組織的相互作用。該公司由 Tomer Izraeli 於 2005 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列 Raanana。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2035. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2035.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2035 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2035 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Gladstone Capital Corp. is real estate investment trust, which owns net leased industrial, commercial, retail property and selectively makes long-term industrial and commercial mortgage loans. It offers debt and equity financing for growth, acquisition and recapitalization with an investment. The company was founded by David J. Gladstone on May 30, 2001 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Gladstone Capital Corp.是一家房地產投資信託公司，擁有淨租賃的工業、商業、零售物業，並選擇性地提供長期工業和商業抵押貸款。它透過投資為成長、收購和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。該公司由 David J. Gladstone 於 2001 年 5 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF combines a strategic, long-term large-capitalization U.S. equity exposure with a systematic, model-driven managed futures strategy that takes long and short positions globally across equities, fixed income, currencies, and commodities. The fund implements its multi-asset framework via direct stock investments and substantial derivative exposures, while managing a portion of its commodity risk through a wholly owned Cayman Islands subsidiary.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通管理期貨Plus ETF將戰略性長期大盤美國股票敞口與系統化、模型驅動的管理期貨策略相結合，該策略在全球範圍內持有股票、固定收益、貨幣和大宗商品的多頭和空頭頭寸。該基金透過直接股票投資和大量衍生性商品曝險實施其多元資產框架，同時透過全資擁有的開曼群島子公司管理部分商品風險。

info.description: Invesco Equal Weight 0-30 Year Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the ICE 1-30 Year Laddered Maturity U.S. Treasury Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the components of the index. The index provider compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to track the performance of up to 30 U.S. Treasury Notes or Bonds representing the annual February maturity ladder across the yield curve.
info.description_zh: Invesco 等權重 0-30 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 1-30 年階梯式到期美國國債指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金一般會將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的成分股。指數提供者編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在追蹤最多 30 種美國國債或債券的表現，代表每年 2 月殖利率曲線上的到期階梯。

info.description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of gene therapy treatment options for rare and devastating pediatric diseases. The firm's multi-platform development approach applies the lentiviral vector and adeno-associated viral vector gene therapy platforms. Its clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for the treatment of Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult to treat genetic disease that leads to bone marrow failure and potentially cancer. The company was founded on July 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Cranbury, NJ.
info.description_zh: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發針對罕見和毀滅性兒科疾病的基因療法。該公司的多平台開發方法應用了慢病毒載體和腺相關病毒載體基因治療平台。其臨床計畫是基於 LVV 的基因療法，用於治療範可尼貧血 (FA)，這是一種難以治療的遺傳性疾病，會導致骨髓衰竭和潛在的癌症。該公司成立於1999年7月7日，總部位於新澤西州克蘭伯里。

info.description: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. engages in the provision of a global storytelling platform. The firm allows creators and users to discover, create, and share new content. Its brands include Munpia, Yonder, Studio Lico, LINE, and Creator Studios. The company was founded by Jun-Koo Kim in 2005 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. 致力於提供全球說故事平台。該公司允許創作者和用戶發現、創建和分享新內容。旗下品牌包括 Munpia、Yonder、Studio Lico、LINE 和 Creator Studios。該公司由 Jun-Koo Kim 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: SNDL, Inc. is a licensed producer that crafts small-batch cannabis using state-of-the-art indoor facilities. It operates through the following segments: Liquor Retail, Cannabis Retail, Cannabis Operations, and Investments. The Liquor Retail segment consists of wines, beers, and spirits through owned liquor stores. The Cannabis Retail segment comprises of the private sale of adult-use cannabis through owned and franchise retail cannabis stores. The Cannabis Operations covers the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use, and medical markets domestically and for export. The Investments segment includes the deployment of capital to investment opportunities. The company was founded by Stanley J. Swiatek on August 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: SNDL, Inc. 是一家獲得許可的生產商，使用最先進的室內設施生產小批量大麻。它透過以下部門運作：酒類零售、大麻零售、大麻營運和投資。酒類零售部門透過自有酒類商店銷售葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒。大麻零售部門包括透過自營和特許零售大麻商店私人銷售成人用大麻。大麻業務涵蓋供成人使用以及國內和出口醫療市場使用的大麻的種植、分銷和銷售。投資部門包括將資本部署到投資機會。該公司由Stanley J. Swiatek於2006年8月19日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Long Treasury Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國長期國債指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的期限超過 10 年的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型）。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Avos Global Equities ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of global equity securities, including common and preferred stocks, depositary receipts, REITs, and underlying ETFs. The investment strategy utilizes a proprietary multi-step process that evaluates countries and companies based on long-term structural valuations and short-term market dynamics, ensuring exposure to at least three countries with a significant allocation to non-U.S. developed and emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Avos 全球股票 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於全球股票證券的多元化投資組合（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金和基礎 ETF）來實現長期資本增值。此投資策略採用專有的多步驟流程，根據長期結構性估值和短期市場動態對國家和公司進行評估，確保投資於至少三個國家，並在非美國已開發市場和新興市場上有大量配置。

info.description: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity greater than or equal to twenty years.
info.description_zh: iShares 20+ 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 20+ 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。基礎指數衡量剩餘期限大於或等於二十年的美國財政部公共債務的履行。

info.description: MercadoLibre, Inc. engages in the development of an online commerce platform with a focus on e-commerce and related services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, and Other Countries. The Other Countries segment refers to Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Panama, Peru, Bolivia, Honduras, Nicaragua, El Salvador, Guatemala, Paraguay, Uruguay, and the United States of America. Its products provide a mechanism for buying, selling, and paying as well as collecting, generating leads, and comparing lists through e-commerce transactions. The company was founded by Marcos Eduardo Galperin on October 15, 1999 and is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay.

info.description_zh: Global Indemnity Group LLC 從事提供多元化保險和再保險服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：代理商和保險服務部門、貝爾蒙特核心部門和貝爾蒙特非核心部門。代理和保險服務部門透過管理一般代理機構和相關服務實體從事保險分銷、承保支援、索賠調整和管理以及保險技術服務。貝爾蒙特核心部門從事持續直接保險和假定再保險產品的業務。貝爾蒙特非核心部門從事已不再強調的業務線的保險公司業務。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. engages in the provision of specialty materials to industries and applications. The firm offers refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging, etc. It operates through the Refrigerants & Applied Solutions (RAS) and Electronic & Specialty Materials (ESM) segments. The RAS segment manufactures low global warming potential (LGWP) refrigerants, blowing agents, solvents, and aerosol materials. The ESM segment serves the semiconductor, defense, pharmaceutical, and construction end markets. The company was founded on October 30, 2025 and is headquartered in Morris Plains, NJ.
info.description_zh: Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. 致力於為行業和應用提供特殊材料。該公司提供冷媒、半導體製造、資料中心冷卻、核電、防護纖維、醫療保健包裝等。它透過冷媒和應用解決方案（RAS）以及電子和特殊材料（ESM）部門運作。 RAS 部門生產低全球暖化潛值 (LGWP) 冷媒、發泡劑、溶劑和氣溶膠材料。 ESM 部門服務於半導體、國防、製藥和建築終端市場。該公司成立於2025年10月30日，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯普萊恩斯。

info.description: ScanSource, Inc. engages in the development and provision of technology products and services. It operates through the Specialty Technology Solutions and Intelisys & Advisory segments. The Specialty Technology Solutions segment includes enterprise mobile computing, data capture, barcode printing, POS, payments, networking, electronic physical security, cybersecurity and other technologies. The Intelisys & Advisory segment refers to the United States and consists of sales and services to both channel sales partners (Intelisys) and end users (Advisory). The company was founded by Michael L. Baur and Steven H. Owings in December 1992 and is headquartered in Greenville, SC.
info.description_zh: ScanSource, Inc. 從事技術產品和服務的開發和提供。它透過專業技術解決方案和 Intelisys 與諮詢部門運作。專業技術解決方案部門包括企業行動運算、資料收集、條碼列印、POS、支付、網路、電子實體安全、網路安全和其他技術。 Intelisys 和諮詢部門涉及美國，包括向通路銷售合作夥伴 (Intelisys) 和最終用戶 (Advisory) 提供的銷售和服務。該公司由 Michael L. Baur 和 Steven H. Owings 於 1992 年 12 月創立，總部位於南卡羅來納州格林維爾。

info.description: VenHub Global, Inc. engages in the management of fully autonomous and robotic-operated convenience stores. It is involved in utilizing technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and smart inventory management systems for shopping experience of customers. The company was founded by Shahan Ohanessian and Shoushana Ohanessian on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: VenHub Global, Inc. 從事全自動和機器人操作的便利商店的管理。它利用人工智慧（AI）和智慧庫存管理系統等技術來提升顧客的購物體驗。該公司由 Shahan Ohanessian 和 Shoushana Ohanessian 於 2023 年 1 月 31 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Okta, Inc. engages in the provision of an identity management platform for enterprises. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: United States and International. Its products include single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, access gateway, API access management, authentication, adaptive MFA and lifecycle management. The company was founded by Todd McKinnon and J. Frederic Kerrest in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

info.description: Bonk, Inc. is a wellness and dietary supplement company. It has developed Sure Shot, the first patented wellness product on Earth that lowers blood alcohol content by supporting its metabolism, while boosting clarity, energy, and overall mood. The company was founded by Brian S. John on October 24, 2018 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Bonk, Inc. 是一家健康和膳食補充劑公司。該公司開發了 Sure Shot，這是地球上第一個獲得專利的健康產品，透過支持新陳代謝來降低血液中的酒精含量，同時提高清晰度、能量和整體情緒。該公司由 Brian S. John 於 2018 年 10 月 24 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Materialise NV engages in the provision of additive manufacturing software and 3D printing services. It operates through the following segments: Materialise Software, Materialise Medical, and Materialise Manufacturing. The Materialise Software segment offers proprietary software worldwide through programs and platforms that enable companies to set up reliable and sustainable 3D printing production. The Materialise Medical segment includes medical software solutions, medical devices and other related products and services. The Materialise Manufacturing segment provides 3D printed services to industrial and commercial customers. The company was founded by Wilfried Vancraen and Hilde Ingelaere on June 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Materialise NV 從事提供積層製造軟體和 3D 列印服務。它透過以下部門運作：Materialize Software、Materialise Medical 和 Materialise Manufacturing。 Materialise Software 部門透過程式和平台在全球範圍內提供專有軟體，使公司能夠建立可靠且可持續的 3D 列印生產。 Materialise Medical 部門包括醫療軟體解決方案、醫療設備以及其他相關產品和服務。 Materialise Manufacturing 部門為工業和商業客戶提供 3D 列印服務。該公司由 Wilfried Vancraen 和 Hilde Ingelaere 於 1990 年 6 月 28 日創立，總部位於比利時魯汶。

info.description: enGene Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing gene therapies. It is developing non-viral gene therapies based on its novel and proprietary dually derived chitosan, or DDX, gene delivery platform, which allows localized delivery of multiple gene cargos directly to mucosal tissues and other organs. The company was founded by Anthony T. Cheung on April 24, 2023 and is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Canada.
info.description_zh: enGene Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發基因療法。該公司正在開發基於其新穎且專有的雙衍生殼聚醣（DDX）基因遞送平台的非病毒基因療法，該平台允許將多種基因貨物直接局部遞送至黏膜組織和其他器官。該公司由 Anthony T. Cheung 於 2023 年 4 月 24 日創立，總部位於加拿大聖洛朗。

info.description: Keros Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of novel treatments for patients suffering from hematological and musculoskeletal disorders with unmet medical need. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Lexington, MA.

info.description: Quantum Cyber NV engages in assembling an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, quantum-accelerated system-of-systems autonomous defense platform. It integrates drone warfare, counter-UAS, autonomous naval mine countermeasures, EMP shielding, anti-drone ammunition, command-and-control, and quantum antenna applications. The company was founded by Andrew May, Luciano Marraffini, Rodolphe Barrangou, Nessan Bermingham, Rachel Haurwitz, Erik Sontheimer, Jennifer Doudna and Derrick Rossi in May 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

The firm offers a mobile and web based crypto asset exchange platform, proprietary wallet infrastructure and custody solutions, over-the-counter trading solutions tailored to institutions and professionals, a digital art auction platform, a proprietary United States dollar backed stablecoin, and a credit card product that offers crypto asset rewards on customer purchases. The company was founded by Tyler Winklevoss and Cameron Winklevoss in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Synopsys, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design automation (EDA) software that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits (ICs). It also offers semiconductor intellectual property (IP) products. It operates through the Design Automation and Design IP segments. The Design Automation segment includes silicon design, verification of products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration of products and services. The Design IP segment refers to interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company was founded by Aart J. de Geus, Bill Krieger, Dave Gregory, and Rick Rudell in December 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Synopsys, Inc. 致力於提供工程師用來設計和測試積體電路 (IC) 的電子設計自動化 (EDA) 軟體。它還提供半導體知識產權（IP）產品。它透過設計自動化和設計 IP 部門運作。設計自動化部門包括晶片設計、產品和服務驗證、Ansys 產品以及產品和服務的系統整合。設計IP部分涉及介面、基礎、安全和嵌入式處理器IP、IP子系統和IP實施服務，主要為半導體和電子行業的公司提供服務。該公司由 Aart J. de Geus、Bill Krieger、Dave Gregory 和 Rick Rudell 於 1986 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Monro, Inc. engages in the operation of chain stores that provide automotive undercar repair and tire services. It also offers services for brakes, mufflers and exhaust systems, and steering, drive train, suspension and wheel alignment. It operates under the brand names Monro Auto Service and Tire Centers, Tire Choice Auto Service Centers, Mr. Tire Auto Service Centers, Car-X Tire & Auto, Tire Warehouse Tires for Less, Ken Towery's Tire & Auto Care, Tire Barn Warehouse, and Free Service Tire and Auto Centers. The company was founded by Charles J. August in 1957 and is headquartered in Fairport, NY.

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PANW Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PANW. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PANW and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF seeks daily inverse investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: CRWD). The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. engages in the development of an internal pipeline of off-the-shelf CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies. Its tools and technologies provide transformative capabilities to basic and applied biological research, therapeutic development, agricultural biotechnology, and industrial biotechnology. The company was founded by Jennifer A. Doudna, Rachel E. Haurwitz, Martin Jinek and James Berger on October 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. 致力於開發現成的 CAR-T 和 CAR-NK 細胞療法的內部管道。其工具和技術為基礎和應用生物學研究、治療開發、農業生物技術和工業生物技術提供變革能力。該公司由 Jennifer A. Doudna、Rachel E. Haurwitz、Martin Jinek 和 James Berger 於 2011 年 10 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: Ascentage Pharma Group International Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the development of novel therapies for cancers, hepatitis B virus, or HBV, and age-related diseases. The company was founded by Da Jun Yang, Wang Shao Meng and Ming Guo in May 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 亞盛醫藥集團國際有限公司是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它致力於開發癌症、乙型肝炎病毒或 HBV 以及與年齡相關的疾病的新療法。該公司由楊大軍、王少萌和郭明於2009年5月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: MARA Holdings, Inc. is a digital asset technology company, which engages in mining cryptocurrencies with a focus on the Bitcoin ecosystem. It also deals with owning and operating bitcoin mining facilities or data centers, selling proprietary software or technology to third parties operating in the Bitcoin ecosystem, offering advisory and consulting services to support Bitcoin mining ventures in domestic and international jurisdictions, and generating electricity from renewable energy resources or methane gas capture to power Bitcoin mining projects. The company was founded on February 23, 2010 and is headquartered in Hallandale Beach, FL.

Bender in 2012 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.

It operates through the following segments: Cell Therapy, BioBanking, Degenerative Disease, and Other. The Cell Therapy segment consists of the therapies the company is researching and developing. The BioBanking segment focuses on stem cells from umbilical cords and placentas and provides storage of such cells on behalf of individuals for future use. The Degenerative Disease segment offers products used in surgical and wound care markets. The company was founded by Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celularity, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發現成的胎盤來源同種異體細胞療法，用於治療癌症、免疫和傳染病。它透過以下部門運作：細胞治療、生物銀行、退化性疾病等。細胞療法部門由公司正在研究和開發的療法組成。生物銀行部門專注於來自臍帶和胎盤的幹細胞，並代表個人儲存此類細胞以供將來使用。退化性疾病部門提供外科和傷口護理市場的產品。該公司由 Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新澤西州弗洛勒姆公園。

info.description: Biomerica, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical diagnostic products designed for the early detection and monitoring of chronic diseases and medical conditions. The firm focuses on gastrointestinal diseases, food intolerances, diabetes, and certain esoteric tests. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, North America, Asia, South America, and Middle East. The company was founded in September 1971 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Biomerica, Inc. 從事醫療診斷產品的開發、製造和行銷，這些產品旨在早期檢測和監測慢性疾病和醫療狀況。該公司專注於胃腸道疾病、食物不耐受、糖尿病和某些深奧的測試。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：歐洲、北美、亞洲、南美和中東。該公司成立於 1971 年 9 月，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description_zh: Barinthus Biotherapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發抗原特異性免疫治療藥物，誘導 T 細胞治療慢性病毒感染、自體免疫疾病和癌症。它還專注於臨床和臨床前階段治療和預防計劃的管道。該公司由 Adrian Hill 和 Dame Sarah Gilbert 於 2021 年 3 月創立，總部位於英國迪德科特。

info.description: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solution services. It provides tailor-made software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) services, and white-labelled software design and development services. info.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. engages in the development of therapeutic products for the treatment of rare and orphan diseases. Its product pipeline includes QRX003, QRX004, QRX007, and QRX008. The company was founded by Michael Myers and Denise Carter on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.

info.description: Chagee Holdings Ltd. engages in the sales of freshly-made tea drinks, related raw materials, packaging, teahouse equipment, and other supplies. Its products include tea latte, teapuccino, iced oriental tea, teaspresso, and other creative tea drinks. info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2028 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: Pasithea Therapeutics Corp. is a biotechnology company focused on the research and discovery of new and treatments for psychiatric and neurological disorders. The company was founded by Yassine Bendiabdallah and Lawrence J. Steinman on May 12, 2020 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Pasithea Therapeutics Corp. 是一家生物技術公司，專注於研究和發現精神和神經疾病的新療法。該公司由 Yassine Bendiabdallah 和 Lawrence J. Steinman 於 2020 年 5 月 12 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2044 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2044 and December 15, 2044, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2044 年期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2044 年 1 月 1 日至 2044 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。

info.description: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. operates as a mobile game publishing company. It engages in partnering with small- and medium-sized game developers for game publishing solutions. The company was founded by Feng Xie on August 25, 2016 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. 是一家手機遊戲發行公司。它與中小型遊戲開發商合作提供遊戲發行解決方案。該公司由謝鋒於2016年8月25日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: NOVONIX Ltd. engages in the revolutionizing the global lithium-ion battery industry with innovative, sustainable technologies, high-performance materials, and more efficient production methods. The firm manufactures industry battery cell testing equipment, is growing its high-performance synthetic graphite material manufacturing operations, and has developed a patented all-dry, zero-waste cathode synthesis process. The firm operates through the following segments: Battery Materials, Battery Technology, and Graphite Exploration. NOVONIX was founded by Gregory Alexander John Baynton in April 2012 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: NOVONIX Ltd. 致力於透過創新、永續技術、高性能材料和更有效率的生產方法徹底改變全球鋰離子電池產業。該公司製造工業電池測試設備，正在發展其高性能合成石墨材料製造業務，並開發了專利的全乾式、零廢物陰極合成流程。該公司透過以下部門運作：電池材料、電池技術和石墨勘探。 NOVONIX 由 Gregory Alexander John Baynton 於 2012 年 4 月創立，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Focus Five Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Focus Five 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於行業的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Vera Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of transformative treatments for immunological diseases. Its product includes the TRUTAKNA injection. The company was founded by Marshall W. Fordyce in May 2016 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

info.description: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. engages in the development and commercialization of drugs for gastrointestinal (GI), infectious diseases, and oncology. The firm's products include Talicia, Movantik, and Aemcolo. It operates through the Commercial Operations and Research and Development segments. The Commercial Operations segment covers areas relating to commercial sales through a subsidiary in the United States. The Research and Development segment includes the study and licensing of therapeutic candidates. The company was founded by Dror Ben-Asher and Ori Shilo on August 3, 2009 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. 從事胃腸道 (GI)、傳染病和腫瘤學藥物的開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括 Talicia、Movantik 和 Aemcolo。它透過商業營運和研發部門進行運作。商業營運部門涵蓋與透過美國子公司進行商業銷售相關的領域。研究與開發部門包括候選治療藥物的研究和許可。該公司由 Dror Ben-Asher 和 Ori Shilo 於 2009 年 8 月 3 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long SPOT Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of SPOT, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭現貨每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 200% 每日槓桿敞口的 SPOT 價格，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sales of stainless steel band, copper strip, welded stainless steel pipes and fittings, valve, light industry machinery equipment, and other stainless steel products. The company was founded by Jian Cong Huang and Guo Lin Wang on May 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中康國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，主要從事不銹鋼帶、銅帶、不銹鋼焊接管材及管件、閥門、輕工業機械設備等不銹鋼產品的製造和銷售。該公司由黃健聰和王果林於2015年5月13日創立，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale oil seeds through its subsidiaries. It focuses on acquiring, engaging in a share exchange, share reconstruction, and amalgamation with, purchasing all or substantially all the assets of, entering contractual arrangements with, or engaging in any other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on December 29, 2022 and is headquartered in Cootamundra, Australia.
info.description_zh: 澳洲油籽控股有限公司透過其子公司從事油籽生產和銷售。它的重點是收購一個或多個企業或實體、進行股份交換、股份重組、合併、購買其全部或幾乎所有資產、與其簽訂合約安排或進行任何其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2022年12月29日，總部位於澳洲庫塔曼德拉。

info.description: Purple Biotech Ltd. is a clinical-stage company, which engages in developing first-in-class therapies that seek to overcome tumor immune evasion and drug resistance. The oncology pipeline includes CM24, NT219, and CAPTN-3. The CM24 is a humanized monoclonal antibody that blocks CEACAM1, which supports tumor immune evasion and survival through multiple pathways. The NT219 is a dual inhibitor, novel small molecule that simultaneously targets IRS1/2 and STAT3. The CAPTN-3, a preclinical platform of conditionally activated tri-specific antibodies, which engage both T cells and NK cells to induce a strong, localized immune response within the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by John Paul Waymack on August 12, 1968 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Purple Biotech Ltd.是一家臨床階段公司，致力於開發一流的療法，旨在克服腫瘤免疫逃脫和抗藥性。腫瘤藥物管線包括 CM24、NT219 和 CAPTN-3。 CM24 是一種人源化單株抗體，可阻斷 CEACAM1，從而透過多種途徑支持腫瘤免疫逃脫和存活。 NT219 是一種雙重抑制劑，是同時針對 IRS1/2 和 STAT3 的新型小分子。 CAPTN-3 是一個由條件活化的三特異性抗體組成的臨床前平台，可與 T 細胞和 NK 細胞結合，在腫瘤微環境中誘導強烈的局部免疫反應。該公司由 John Paul Waymack 於 1968 年 8 月 12 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Cadiz, Inc. is a land and water resource development company, which engages in the acquisition and development of land with water resources for groundwater supply, groundwater storage, and agriculture. It operates through the following segments: Land and Water Resources and Water Filtration Technology. The Land and Water Resources segment consists of activities related to properties in the eastern Mojave Desert and development of the Mojave Groundwater Bank. The Water Filtration Technology segment includes provision of innovative water filtration technology solutions for impaired and contaminated groundwater sources. The company was founded by Keith Brackpool in 1983 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

info.description: Yatra Online, Inc. engages in the business of selling travel products and solutions. It operates through the following segments: Airline Tickets, Hotel and Holiday Packages, and Other Services. The Airline Tickets segment consists of the sale of airline tickets as well as airline tickets sold as part of the holiday package. The Hotel and Holiday Packages refers to the sales of hotel rooms and travel packages. The Other Services segment includes rail tickets, bus tickets, taxi rentals, and ancillary value-added services. The company was founded by Dhruv Shringi, Manish Amin, and Sabina Chopra in 2005 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

The company's immunotherapy platform activates both the innate and adaptive immune systems to create long term immunological memory. ImmunityBio was founded by Patrick Soon-Shiong in 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ImmunityBio, Inc.是一家臨床階段免疫療法公司。它開發下一代療法，驅動免疫原性機制來戰勝癌症和傳染病。該公司的免疫治療平台可激活先天性和適應性免疫系統，以創建長期免疫記憶。 ImmunityBio 由 Patrick Soon-Shiong 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Hadron Energy, Inc. is a nuclear technology company. It focuses on developing compact micro-modular nuclear reactors (MMRs) designed to provide continuous, carbon-free power for high-demand applications. The company was founded by Samuel Gibson in May 2024 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Hadron Energy, Inc.是一家核子技術公司。它專注於開發緊湊型微型模組化核反應器（MMR），旨在為高需求應用提供連續、無碳的電力。該公司由 Samuel Gibson 於 2024 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Future FinTech Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a real name blockchain based e-commerce platform. Its activities include a blockchain-based online shopping mall platform, Chain Cloud Mall (CCM), a cross-border e-commerce platform (NONOGIRL), an incubator for blockchain based application projects, and a digital payment system (DCON). It operates through the following segments: Supply Chain Financing/Trading, Brokerage Service, and Others. The company was founded on June 29, 1998 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Future FinTech Group, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事基於實名區塊鏈的電子商務平台的營運。其活動包括基於區塊鏈的線上購物中心平台Chain Cloud Mall（CCM）、跨境電子商務平台（NONOGIRL）、基於區塊鏈的應用專案孵化器以及數位支付系統（DCON）。它透過以下部門運作：供應鏈融資/貿易、經紀服務和其他。該公司成立於1998年6月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Neurogene, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of product portfolio of genetic medicines for rare neurological diseases. The company was founded in May 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Krainer in June 2014 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in broker or dealer and proprietary trading businesses. It offers custody and service accounts for hedge and mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, registered investment advisors, proprietary trading groups, introducing brokers, and individual investors. The company was founded by Thomas Pechy Peterffy in 1977 and is headquartered in Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc.是一家投資控股公司，從事經紀商或交易商以及自營交易業務。它為對沖基金和共同基金、交易所交易基金、註冊投資顧問、自營交易集團、介紹經紀人和個人投資者提供託管和服務帳戶。該公司由 Thomas Pechy Peterffy 於 1977 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州格林威治。

info.description: VanEck Digital Transformation ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Digital Assets Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of Digital Transformation Companies. The index is a global index that tracks the performance of Digital Transformation Companies. The fund will not invest in digital assets (including cryptocurrencies) (i) directly or (ii) indirectly through the use of digital asset derivatives. It also will not invest in initial coin offerings. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Airship AI Holdings, Inc. engages in a video, sensor, and data management surveillance platform which focuses on the provision of software services. Its products include Airship Acropolis OS, Airship Command, and Airship Outpost. The company was founded by Derek Xu on June 30, 2003 and is headquartered in Redmond, WA.
info.description_zh: Airship AI Holdings, Inc.從事視訊、感測器和資料管理監控平台，專注於提供軟體服務。其產品包括Airship Acropolis OS、Airship Command、Airship Outpost等。該公司由 Derek Xu 於 2003 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州雷德蒙德。

info.description: Acorn Energy, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of technology driven solutions for energy infrastructure asset management. It operates through the Power Generation (PG) and Cathodic Protection (CP) segments. The PG segment offers wireless remote monitoring and control systems and services for critical assets, as well as Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The CP segment includes remote monitoring of cathodic protection systems on gas pipelines for gas utilities and pipeline companies. The company was founded by George Morgenstern in 1986 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Acorn Energy, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為能源基礎設施資產管理提供技術驅動的解決方案。它透過發電（PG）和陰極保護（CP）部門運作。 PG 部門為關鍵資產以及物聯網 (IoT) 應用提供無線遠端監控和控制系統及服務。陰極保護領域包括為天然氣公用事業公司和管道公司提供天然氣管道陰極保護系統的遠端監控。該公司由 George Morgenstern 於 1986 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Global X Blockchain ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Blockchain Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of blockchain technology. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Nano Labs Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in design and provision of product solution of fabless integrated circuit. It offers high throughput computing chips, high performance computing chips, distributed computing and storage solutions, smart network interface cards, vision computing chips, and distributed rendering. The company was founded in July 2019 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Nano Labs Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事無晶圓廠積體電路設計和產品解決方案提供。它提供高吞吐量運算晶片、高效能運算晶片、分散式運算和儲存解決方案、智慧型網路介面卡、視覺運算晶片和分散式渲染。公司成立於2019年7月，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: TAO Synergies Inc. is engaged in the convergence between cryptocurrency and artificial intelligence. It also focuses on research and development activities related to developing therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 31, 2012 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TAO Synergies Inc. 致力於加密貨幣與人工智慧的整合。它還專注於與開發神經退化性疾病療法相關的研究和開發活動。該公司成立於2012年10月31日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Exyn Technologies, Inc. is a robotics and artificial intelligence company developing autonomous mapping and navigation systems for complex, GPS-denied environments. The firm's proprietary technology enables aerial and ground robotic systems to navigate, map and collect real-time 3D data in environments where GPS, communications or prior maps may be unavailable or unreliable. The company was founded by Nader Elm and Vijay Kumar on May 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.

It focuses on stablecoin rails with agentic artificial intelligence (AI) to deliver financial access, education, and actionable intelligence to Africa, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. info.description_zh: SkyAI, Inc. 致力於提供代理金融平台。它專注於具有代理人工智慧（AI）的穩定幣軌道，為非洲、拉丁美洲和東南亞提供金融服務、教育和可操作的情報。該公司由 Alan R. Blackman 和 Barry B. Berler 於 2017 年 12 月 16 日創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: MMTec, Inc. engages in holding an equity interest in MM Future. It operates through the Gujia, MM Future and HC Securities, and MM Global segments. The MM Global segment introduces brokers that clear all transactions through clearing broker-dealers and earns commission income, placement agent service fees, and other related income from customers. The company was founded on January 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: MMTec, Inc. 持有 MM Future 的股權。它透過顧家、MM Future 和 HC Securities 以及 MM Global 部門進行運作。顧家、MM期貨和慧聰證券部門提供市場數據和諮詢服務。 MM Global部門引進經紀商，透過清算經紀交易商清算所有交易，並從客戶那裡賺取佣金收入、配售代理服務費和其他相關收入。該公司成立於2018年1月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of platforms for performing minimally invasive surgical procedures in the brain and heart. The firm conducts its procedures under direct, intra-procedural magnetic resonance imaging guidance. Its product platform consists of the ClearPoint system and ClearTrace system. The company was founded by Paul A. Bottomley on March 12, 1998 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
