info.description: Atlantic American Corp. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the life, health, and property and casualty insurance industries. It operates through the following segments: American Southern, Bankers Fidelity, and Corporate & Other. The American Southern segment operates in the property and casualty insurance market. The Bankers Fidelity segment operates in the life and health insurance market. The Corporate and Other segment is from external sources. The company was founded on January 4, 1968 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlantic American Corp.是一家保險控股公司，從事人壽、健康、財產和意外保險業。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國南方航空、富達銀行和企業及其他部門。美國南方分部從事財產和意外保險市場。 Bankers Fidelity 部門在人壽保險和健康保險市場開展業務。公司及其他部門來自外部來源。該公司成立於 1968 年 1 月 4 日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Valion Bio, Inc. operates as a bio-electronic health-tech company, which develops micro current therapy solutions for chronic diseases and conditions. The company was founded by Jennifer Ernst and John Claude on September 22, 2016 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: Valion Bio, Inc. 是一家生物電子健康科技公司，致力於開發針對慢性疾病和病症的微電流治療解決方案。該公司由 Jennifer Ernst 和 John Claude 於 2016 年 9 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: TNL Mediagene engages in digital advertising, integrated marketing, marketing survey, artificial intelligence technology, data analysis, content service platform, and production of audio-visual programs. It operates media, technology, and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan and Taiwan. The company was founded on May 25, 2023 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: TNL Mediagene 從事數位廣告、整合行銷、行銷調查、人工智慧技術、數據分析、內容服務平台和視聽節目製作。該公司主要在日本和台灣經營媒體、科技和數位工作室業務。該公司成立於2023年5月25日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Smartbird, Inc. is a global lifestyle brand that innovates with naturally derived materials to make footwear and apparel products in a better way, while treading lighter on the planet. It offers Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, and Gift Cards. The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Smartbird, Inc. 是一個全球生活風格品牌，利用天然材料進行創新，以更好的方式製造鞋類和服裝產品，同時在地球上邁出更輕的腳步。它提供男鞋、女鞋、男裝、女裝、襪子和禮品卡。該公司由 Timothy Brown 和 Joseph Zev Zwillinger 於 2015 年 5 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Core AI Holdings, Inc. engages in mobile game development and publishing. It creates games for players worldwide while empowering other developers to deliver player-focused apps and games to enthusiasts. It focuses on harnessing the power of artificial intelligence to build transformative and scalable offerings across multiple verticals. The company was founded by Marc Seelenfreund on October 15, 1986 and is headquartered in Surrey, Canada.
info.description_zh: Core AI Holdings, Inc.從事手機遊戲開發和發行。它為世界各地的玩家創造遊戲，同時幫助其他開發者向愛好者提供以玩家為中心的應用程式和遊戲。它專注於利用人工智慧的力量在多個垂直領域中建立變革性和可擴展的產品。該公司由Marc Seelenfreund於1986年10月15日創立，總部位於加拿大薩裡。

info.description: Vince Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture, design, and sale of luxury apparel and accessories. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Direct-to-Consumer, and Rebecca Taylor and Parker. The Wholesale segment deals with the sale of products to premier department stores and specialty stores in the U.S. and in selected international markets. The Direct-to-Consumer segment includes retail and outlet stores and its e-commerce business. The company was founded by Rea Laccone and Christopher LaPolice in 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Vince Holding Corp. 從事奢華服裝和配件的製造、設計和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：批發部門、直接面向消費者部門以及麗貝卡泰勒和帕克部門。批發部門負責向美國和選定的國際市場的頂級百貨公司和專賣店銷售產品。直接面向消費者部門包括零售店和直銷店及其電子商務業務。該公司由 Rea Laccone 和 Christopher LaPolice 於 2002 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: BGM Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the technology fields of AI application, intelligent robots, algorithmic computing power, cloud computing, and biopharmaceuticals. It operates through the following segments: Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and Traditional Chinese Medicine Derivatives (TCMD); Heparin Products and Sausage Casing; and Fertilizer. The Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and TCMD segment focuses on the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of oxytetracycline products, licorice products, and TCMD. The Heparin Products and Sausage Casing segment treats cardiovascular diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and hemodialysis. The Fertilizer segment includes Xiongguan, Organic Fertilizer and Xiongguan, and Organic-Inorganic Compound Fertilizer. The company was founded on February 7, 2019 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BGM Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，涉足人工智慧應用、智慧機器人、演算法算力、雲端運算、生物製藥等技術領域。它透過以下部門運作：土黴素和甘草產品部門，以及中藥衍生品部門（TCMD）；肝素產品和腸衣；和肥料。土黴素和甘草產品以及TCMD部門專注於土黴素產品、甘草產品和TCMD的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。肝素產品和腸衣部門治療心血管疾病、腦血管疾病和血液透析。肥料業務包括雄冠、有機肥料和雄冠、有機無機復混肥。公司成立於2019年2月7日，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Minerva Neurosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of a portfolio of product candidates to treat central nervous system diseases. It develops Roluperidone for the treatment of negative symptoms in patients with schizophrenia and MIN-301 for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. The company was founded by Rogerio Vivaldi Coelho and Goeffrey Robin Race on April 23, 2007 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Minerva Neurosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於治療中樞神經系統疾病的候選產品組合的開發和商業化。該公司開發用於治療精神分裂症患者陰性症狀的 Roluperidone 和用於治療帕金森氏症的 MIN-301。該公司由 Rogerio Vivaldi Coelho 和 Goeffrey Robin Race 於 2007 年 4 月 23 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: Nocera, Inc. is a holding company, which through its subsidiary engages in the aquaculture consulting and management business. Its services include design, install, build, and manage aquaculture investment and projects; pilot and management services to aquaculture companies and new aquaculture projects; and offers equipment and materials from suppliers. The company was founded on February 1, 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: Nocera, Inc.是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事水產養殖諮詢和管理業務。其服務包括設計、安裝、建造和管理水產養殖投資和專案；為水產養殖公司和新水產養殖專案提供試點和管理服務；並提供來自供應商的設備和材料。公司成立於2002年2月1日，總部位於台灣新北市。

info.description: Fold Holdings, Inc. engages in providing Bitcoin-focused financial services. The company was founded on February 14, 2025 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Fold Holdings, Inc. 致力於提供以比特幣為中心的金融服務。該公司成立於2025年2月14日，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: WeShop Holdings Ltd. engages in providing a shoppable social network. It offers shopping in fashion and accessories, health and beauty, home and DIY, food and drink, travel and holidays, tech and electronics, and other popular categories. It includes a library of shoppable product reviews from a digital online shopping mall on mobile devices. The company was founded by John Garner on September 21, 2012 and is headquartered in Jersey, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: WeShop Holdings Ltd. 致力於提供可購物的社交網路。它提供時尚和配件、健康和美容、家居和 DIY、食品和飲料、旅遊和度假、科技和電子產品以及其他熱門類別的購物。它包括來自行動裝置上的數位線上購物中心的可購物產品評論庫。該公司由約翰·加納於2012年9月21日創立，總部位於英國澤西島。

info.description: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. engages in the development of a breast cancer immunotherapy designed to prevent the recurrence of breast cancer following surgery. The company was founded by Eric Rothe on August 29, 2006 and is headquartered in Stafford, TX.
info.description_zh: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. 致力於乳癌免疫療法的開發，旨在預防乳癌手術後復發。該公司由 Eric Rothe 於 2006 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯塔福德。

info.description: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. engages in the recycling, production, and trading of recycled scrap metals. Its products include copper alloy ingot, recycled aluminum, recycled tin, recycled zinc, recycled iron, and plastic beads. The company was founded on April 17, 2024 and is headquartered in Bulacan, Philippines.
info.description_zh: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. 從事再生廢金屬的回收、生產和貿易。其產品包括銅合金錠、再生鋁、再生錫、再生鋅、再生鐵和塑膠珠。該公司成立於2024年4月17日，總部位於菲律賓布拉幹省。

info.description: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. is a self-managed real estate investment trust, which invests in a diverse multi-tenant portfolio of real estate assets. It operates through the following segments: Office and Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties, and Retail Properties. The Office and Industrial Properties segment consists of office buildings and an industrial property leased to a variety of tenants ranging from small businesses to large public companies. The Model Home Properties segment consists of model home residential properties leased to homebuilders. The Retail Properties segment includes shopping centers. The company was founded by Jack Kendrick Heilbron on September 28, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. 是一家自我管理的房地產投資信託公司，投資於多元化的多租戶房地產資產組合。它透過以下部門運作：辦公室和工業地產、樣板房地產和零售地產。辦公和工業地產部門包括辦公大樓和工業地產，租賃給從小型企業到大型上市公司等各種租戶。樣品屋物業部門包括出租給房屋建築商的樣品屋住宅物業。零售物業部門包括購物中心。該公司由 Jack Kendrick Heilbron 於 1999 年 9 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Taoping, Inc. operates as block chain technology and smart cloud services provider. It operates through the following segments: Cloud-based Technology, Blockchain Technology, Traditional Information Technology. The CBT segment includes the company's cloud based products and data storage related services sold to private sectors. The BT segment is the company's Crypto currency mining initiative. The TIT segment is involved in the company's project-based technology products and services sold to the public sector such as Geographic Information System, Digital Public Security Technology, and Digital Hospital Information Systems. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 淘屏公司是一家區塊鏈技術和智慧雲端服務提供商。它透過以下部門運作：基於雲端的技術、區塊鏈技術、傳統資訊技術。 CBT 部門包括該公司向私營部門出售的基於雲端的產品和資料儲存相關服務。 BT 部門是該公司的加密貨幣挖礦計劃。 TIT部門涉及該公司向公共部門銷售的基於專案的技術產品和服務，例如地理資訊系統、數位公共安全技術和數位醫院資訊系統。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FIG Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of FIG. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of FIG, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund manager will attempt to achieve its investment objective without regard to overall market movement or the increase or decrease in the value of FIG. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍長期Fig 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為Fig 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，符合FIG 的價格，與基金的投資目標一致。基金管理人將嘗試實現其投資目標，而不考慮整體市場走勢或圖值的增加或減少。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in trading of electronic products and software development. The company was founded by Yue Zhu on April 6, 2007 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

info.description_zh: YY Group Holding Ltd. 是一家人工智慧原生勞動力管理平台，致力於提供全面設施管理（IFM）。其平台 YY Circle 為飯店、餐飲、零售和其他服務業提供解決方案，以預測、規劃和優化勞動力部署。該公司由付曉偉和張帆於2010年12月創立，總部位於新加坡。

The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market.
info.description_zh: iShares Broad 美元投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 美國企業指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，顧問認為這將有助於基金追蹤標的指數。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人在美國國內市場公開發行的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的表現。

info.description: iShares J.P. Morgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the J.P. Morgan EMBI Global Core Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, emerging market bonds. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is a broad, diverse U.S. dollar-denominated emerging markets debt benchmark that tracks the total return of actively traded external debt instruments in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: iShares 摩根大通美元新興市場債券 ETF 旨在追蹤由以美元計價的新興市場債券組成的摩根大通 EMBI 全球核心指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數是一個廣泛、多樣化的以美元計價的新興市場債務基準，追蹤新興市場國家交易活躍的外債工具的總回報。

info.description: Wisdomtree Bianco Fixed Income Total Return Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bianco Research Fixed Income Total Return Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund primarily invests in the constituent exchange-traded funds ("ETF") of the index. The index, created by Bianco Research Advisors LLC, is composed of approximately 5 to 20 fixed income ETFs that are specifically selected and weighted using a modified market-capitalization weighting scheme to achieve specified factor exposures.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Bianco 固定收益總回報基金旨在追蹤 Bianco Research 固定收益總回報指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金主要投資於指數成分股ETF（ETF）。該指數由 Bianco Research Advisors LLC 創建，由大約 5 至 20 個固定收益 ETF 組成，這些 ETF 是專門選擇的，並使用修改後的市值加權方案進行加權，以實現指定的因子暴露。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2033 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2033 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2033. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results the of ICE 2034 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2034 and December 15, 2034, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2034 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2034 年 1 月 1 日至 2034 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2035 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2035 Maturity US Treasury Index. The index to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2035. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2035 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2035 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該指數追蹤由2035年到期的美國國債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Angel Oak Total Return ETF seeks total return. The fund will concentrate its investments in agency and non-agency RMBS and CMBS, mortgage loans, and other securities of issuers related to mortgages and real estate ("Mortgage Related Instruments"). This means that, under normal circumstances, the fund will invest more than 25% of its assets in Mortgage Related Instruments (measured at the time of purchase). The fund will not concentrate its investments in any other group of industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Angel Oak Total Return ETF 追求總回報。該基金將集中投資於機構和非機構 RMBS 和 CMBS、抵押貸款以及與抵押和房地產相關的發行人的其他證券（「抵押相關工具」）。這意味著，在正常情況下，基金會將25%以上的資產投資於抵押相關工具（以購買時計量）。該基金不會將投資集中於任何其他行業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: eToro Group Ltd. engages in the development, management, and provision of online trading software solutions and services. The firm's trading platform, eToro, allows users to trade financial instruments. It also enables non-professionals to trade in markets that were previously the exclusive arena of professional investors. The company was founded by Johnathan Alexander Assia, Guy Gamzu, David Ring, and Ronen Assia on December 14, 2006 and is headquartered in Bnei Braq, Israel.
info.description_zh: eToro Group Ltd. 從事開發、管理和提供線上交易軟體解決方案和服務。該公司的交易平台 eToro 允許用戶交易金融工具。它還使非專業人士能夠在以前專業投資者專屬的市場上進行交易。該公司由 Johnathan Alexander Assia、Guy Gamzu、David Ring 和 Ronen Assia 於 2006 年 12 月 14 日創立，總部位於以色列 Bnei Braq。

info.description: US Treasury 30 Year Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index (GA30). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 30-year U.S. Treasury bond.
info.description_zh: 美國 30 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 30 年期美國國債指數 (GA30) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 30 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 30 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: The Honest Co., Inc. is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. The company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. The Honest Co., Inc. was founded by Jessica Alba, Christopher Gavigan, Sean Kane, Brian S. Lee, and Jessica Marie Warren in 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: The Honest Co., Inc. 是一家個人護理公司，致力於創造清潔配方和永續設計的產品，涵蓋尿布、濕紙巾、嬰兒個人護理、美容、服裝、家庭護理和健康等類別。公司的使命是透過誠實品牌、誠實團隊和誠實標準的力量挑戰成分、理想和行業。 The Honest Co., Inc. 由 Jessica Alba、Christopher Gavigan、Sean Kane、Brian S. Lee 和 Jessica Marie Warren 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson engages in the provision of telecommunications equipment and related services to mobile and fixed network operators. It operates through the following segments: Networks, Cloud Software, Services, Enterprise, and Other. The Networks segment supports all radio-access technologies and offers hardware, software and related services for both radio access and transport. The Cloud Software segment offers solutions for core networks, business and operational support systems, network design and optimization, and managed network services. The Other segment refers to the media business and other non-allocated business. Segment-level information has also been presented to Other. The company was founded by Lars Magnus Ericsson in 1876 and is headquartered in Kista, Sweden.
info.description_zh: Telefonaktiebolaget LM 愛立信致力於為行動和固定網路業者提供電信設備及相關服務。它透過以下部門運作：網路、雲端軟體、服務、企業和其他。網路部門支援所有無線電存取技術，並為無線電存取和傳輸提供硬體、軟體和相關服務。雲端軟體部門提供核心網路、業務和營運支援系統、網路設計和最佳化以及託管網路服務的解決方案。其他分部是指媒體業務和其他非分配業務。段級資訊也已提交給其他人。該公司由 Lars Magnus Ericsson 於 1876 年創立，總部位於瑞典希斯塔。

info.description: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. engages in the development of medical devices for accurate liver fat measurement for use in metabolic disease detection and GLP-1 drug eligibility and management. The company was founded on July 18, 2007 and is headquartered in Ann Arbor, MI.
info.description_zh: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. 致力於開發用於準確測量肝臟脂肪的醫療設備，用於代謝疾病檢測以及 GLP-1 藥物資格和管理。該公司成立於2007年7月18日，總部位於密西根州安娜堡。

info.description: HCW Biologics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel immunotherapies to lengthen health span by disrupting the link between chronic, low-grade inflammation, and age-related diseases. The firm considers age-related low-grade chronic inflammation as a contributing factor to several chronic diseases and conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, neurodegenerative diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Hing C. Wong on April 2, 2018 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: HCW Biologics Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於發現和開發新型免疫療法，透過破壞慢性、低度發炎和年齡相關疾病之間的關聯來延長健康壽命。該公司認為與年齡相關的低度慢性發炎是導致多種慢性疾病和病症的因素，例如癌症、心血管疾病、糖尿病、神經退化性疾病和自體免疫疾病。該公司由 Hing C. Wong 於 2018 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: Veea, Inc. is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) company, which engages in the sale of smart computing hubs and related subscriptions and licenses. Its solutions include digital inclusion, connected buildings, precision agriculture, TROLLEE, and Internet-of-Things (IoT) and Industrial internet of things (IIoT) connectivity. The company was founded by Allen B. Salmasi and Michael Salmasi in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Veea, Inc. 是一家平台即服務 (PaaS) 公司，從事智慧運算中心及相關訂閱和授權的銷售。其解決方案包括數位包容、互聯建築、精準農業、TROLLEE、物聯網 (IoT) 和工業物聯網 (IIoT) 連接。該公司由 Allen B. Salmasi 和 Michael Salmasi 於 2014 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. engages in the provision of network security solutions to enterprises, service providers, and government entities. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, Israel, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Nir Zuk in March 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. 致力於為企業、服務供應商和政府實體提供網路安全解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、以色列和其他國家。該公司由 Nir ​​Zuk 於 2005 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity products and services to stop breaches. It offers cloud-delivered protection across endpoints, cloud workloads, identity and data, and threat intelligence, managed security services, IT operations management, threat hunting, Zero Trust identity protection, and log management. CrowdStrike serves customers worldwide. The company was founded by George P. Kurtz, Gregg Marston, and Dmitri Alperovitch on November 7, 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. 提供網路安全產品和服務來阻止違規行為。它提供跨端點、雲端工作負載、身分和資料以及威脅情報、託管安全服務、IT 營運管理、威脅搜尋、零信任身分保護和日誌管理的雲端交付保護。 CrowdStrike 為全球客戶提供服務。該公司由 George P. Kurtz、Gregg Marston 和 Dmitri Alperovitch 於 2011 年 11 月 7 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Xtrackers Cybersecurity Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cyber Security ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the field of cybersecurity and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Cyber​​security Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Cyber​​ Security ESG 篩選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支之前）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在網路安全領域開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Cybersecurity ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Cybersecurity Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from increased adoption of cybersecurity technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Cyber​​security ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 網路安全指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數旨在為那些能夠從網路安全技術的採用增加中受益的交易所上市公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Beam Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the establishment of integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. Its pipeline includes BEAM-101, BEAM-302, Engineered Stem Cell Antibody Paired Evasion (ESCAPE), BEAM-301, and BEAM-201. The company was founded by David R. Liu, Feng Zhang, Alexis Komor, Nicole Gaudelli, and J. Keith Joung on January 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Beam Therapeutics, Inc.是一家致力於精準基因藥物綜合平台建置的生物科技公司。其管道包括BEAM-101、BEAM-302、工程幹細胞抗體配對規避（ESCAPE）、BEAM-301和BEAM-201。該公司由 David R. Liu、Feng Zhang、Alexis Komor、Nicole Gaudelli 和 J. Keith Joung 於 2017 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Alps Group, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that integrates research and development, medical services, and wellness solutions. The company focuses on creating a fair healthcare ecosystem, to make advance predictive, preventive, and precision medicine accessible and affordable. The company is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Alps Group, Inc. 是一家集研發、醫療服務和健康解決方案於一體的生技公司。该公司致力于创建一个公平的医疗保健生态系统，使先进的预测性、预防性和精准医疗变得容易获得且负担得起。該公司總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description_zh: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. 從事積體電路和電子設備的設計和開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和日本。該公司由 Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli、Gudmundur A. Hjartarson、K. Bobby Chao 和 K. Charles Janac 於 1988 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Yimutian, Inc. is a holding company which engages in the provision of agricultural business-to-business (B2B) platform.
